rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for an eerie, ghostly, or unsettling manner.

example.english: That abandoned house is hauntingly eerie at night; even getting close to it is chilling.
example.traditional: 嗰間廢屋夜晚陰森森咁，行近少少都令人心寒。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 fai3 uk1 je6 maan5 jam1 sam1 sam1 gam3 haang4 gan6 siu2 siu2 dou1 ling6 jan4 sam1 hon4

rows.note: Use this when “hauntingly” means leaving a powerful impression that lingers in the mind rather than sounding spooky.

example.english: Her final song lingered hauntingly in my mind all night.
example.traditional: 佢最後嗰首歌令人難忘咁，成晚喺我腦入面揮之不去。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 go2 sau2 go1 ling6 jan4 naan4 mong4 gam3 seng4 maan5 hai2 ngo5 nou5 jap6 min6 fai1 zi1 bat1 heoi3
